high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene at what appears to be a beachside promenade or boardwalk. The sky is a deep blue, transitioning into a lighter hue near the horizon, suggesting either dusk or dawn. There is a streetlight illuminating the area, casting a warm glow on the couple in the foreground. In the foreground, there is a man and a woman standing close together, smiling at the camera. The man is wearing a white button-up shirt and dark shorts, while the woman is dressed in a light green crop top and jeans.
